title: Wayback CDX index of openphilanthropy.org/grants/m* (status 200, one row per URL)
note: Queried letter by letter (a to z) on 2026-09-15: 2,737 distinct openphilanthropy.org/grants/<slug>/ pages with a 200 capture after dropping query-string and /page/ variants. No slug begins with metr or model-evaluation (the only 'metr' matches are ayni-institute-movement-ecology-and-metrics and center-for-welfare-metrics-...); no pattern-labs or irregular slug. Present: alignment-research-center-general-support (2), apollo-research-startup-funding, apollo-research-general-support, palisade-research-general-support (2024 and 2025), six securebio-* slugs.
